12.t: Working with data: alcohol and reaction time
q: What was the reaction time with no alcohol?
By how much did reaction time increase at 0.08?
As blood alcohol increases, reaction time increases, and it rises faster at higher levels.
A car at 50 km/h travels 14 m each second. Calculate the extra distance before braking at 0.08, and explain the danger.
0.14 s × 14 m/s = about 2 m extra before braking starts, enough to hit a pedestrian; judgement is also impaired.
